name: Export to CI: install an agent as a PR from the CI tab and see the installation pr_open (SPEC-05 AC-125)
description: Open the seeded Security Reviewer (ids are random per seed, so by click), switch to its CI tab, click '+ Add to CI' and step through Target (GitHub Actions card, acme/payments-api preselected as the only seeded repo), Preview (every bundle path kind is listed: workflow, runner index.js and package.json, memory.jsonl, the agent yaml), Configure (default triggers and results) and Install ('Open a PR with these files' is the default). The hermetic stack sets DEVDIGEST_CI_GITHUB_MOCK=true, so the PR is opened against the ci-scoped mock GitHub client: no network, no model call, no chat. After 'View pull request' appears the wizard is closed through its footer Close button and the CI tab must list acme/payments-api with the 'PR open' state (rendered uppercase by the Badge, so the wait uses 'PR OPEN' and the DOM check uses the raw 'PR open'). Mutates the DB (creates a ci_installations row), so a reused DB re-installs the same repo as an upsert; use e2e:hermetic. Needs the runner bundle built into the server (scripts/e2e.sh builds agent-runner first). UNVERIFIED when authored: the flow was validated statically only.
